utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the ninth. Can you hear me over that fan? Right, let's get the board straight.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, just about. Traffic on the ring road was dreadful. Spent longer looking at the factory than actually getting into it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Lovely view, though. Very desirable industrial estate.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Never mind that, it's the charity bake sale on Friday. Last time the cakes had gone before maintenance got there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: A national scandal. Right, closed stuff first, then what we're actually taking away.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the MV01 yesterday. That's finished, not another one for today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, closed. Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the IM3 last night. All done.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Ah, good. I was looking at the old entry on the board, then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Also, noticed the main conveyor was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just an observation, nothing outstanding from that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, so that's a nights note, not a fresh job.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same sort of note from me: noticed the Main Outfeed Conveyor was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. No ongoing issue to put on the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, both observations only. Not turning either into an action.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Mine hasn't moved, I'm afraid. Still waiting on parts for the GT2 bearing, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, nothing in stores for that yet. Still blocked, not ready work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Leave that blocked. Let's take the safety-critical one first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz Nowak, can you go to Harbour Road to pick up the replacement parts for the Compressed Air Dryer? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll go to Harbour Road and pick up the replacement parts for the Compressed Air Dryer straight away.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's collection only on this entry, yeah? Not fitting them as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, just the collection. We're not adding a fitting job here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine, understood. Collection's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Tomasz Nowak, can you run a function test on the line 1 mould temp next Tuesday? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll run a function test on the line 1 mould temp next Tuesday. Fairly important, got it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit there. Was that a function test, not another repair?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Function test on the line 1 mould temp, yes. That's the action.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, that's what I've got down.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: While I'm on, I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet next week. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tomasz Nowak. Forklift Fleet pre-use checks next week, first priority for that work.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, next week for those. Not saying they jump ahead of the safety-critical collection straight away.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, different windows. That makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 TCU by 11am. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fi. Yes, drop everything for that one. That's the urgent sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Understood. The line 1 TCU sign-off is mine, by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. That's clear, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I'll send the shift handover report round today at 2pm. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Fiona, report round today at 2pm, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, separate from the sign-off. The report isn't the drop-everything job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie Brennan, can you replace the seals on the Main Water Isolation Valve tomorrow morning? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that one. I'm tied up in stores, so I can't commit to the seals.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Olumide Adeyemi, can you take that instead: replace the seals on the Main Water Isolation Valve tomorrow morning? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. I'll replace the seals on the Main Water Isolation Valve tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Thanks. Just making sure it isn't still against me as well.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, Main Water Isolation Valve seals are with me now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide Adeyemi, can you also do a site visit at Tollgate Water Treatment Works with the contractor tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the site visit at Tollgate Water Treatment Works with the contractor tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's alongside the seals tomorrow morning. You're happy taking both?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, those two are manageable. No clash on what I've got.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the dryer on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Thanks, Saz. The risk assessment for work on the dryer, on Friday. Got that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that one's mine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Olumide Adeyemi, can you swap the filter on the water booster by 11am? It's low priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take the water booster by 11am. Haven't got the capacity this morning. Tomorrow's two are fine, but not that as well.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay. Sarah, can you take it instead? Swap the filter on the water booster by 11am. Still low priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that instead. I'll swap the filter on the water booster by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—low priority, but still by 11am? Just checking I've heard that right.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. Low priority, but the due time is still by 11am. I'm accepting it on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And that's separate from the MV01 filter I mentioned. Mine was yesterday and finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. No duplicate job for yours.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. I can cope with two filter names, but apparently not two cake queues.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: You'd still pick the slower queue. Same skill I've got on the ring road.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just to close mine out: urgent line 1 TCU sign-off by 11am, low-priority handover report today at 2pm. Both accepted.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's exactly how we've got them. Nothing extra.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sound. Teams actually behaved this morning. Usually I miss every third word.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Don't tempt it. We've nearly made it through.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we're agreed. Closed items stay closed, parts blocker stays blocked. Thanks, everyone.
